author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: wide domed skull, long ears hanging open to rounded tips with straight inner edges, two jowl lobes meeting at a centre notch, nose bar; mirrored about x=24. Two SQUARE candidates with the neck were rejected: neck posts read as legs, and longer ears pinched against the jowls (internal-spacing review). The rejected drawing was a head arch with a dot nose and a floating smile.
omissions: The neck/chest block under the muzzle is dropped: at 48px any neck post sits closer than 8 units to the ear tips or reads as legs. The rounded nose outline becomes a round-capped bar, and the nose-to-notch line is dropped.
drawing_plan: Mirrored about x=24: skull half-ellipse rx20 ry14, ear cubics to tips (8,36), inner ear edges x=14, jowl cubics to notch (24,37).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'dog': long ears as open lobes hanging from a round skull.
